summary.en-US: Unload the current tab with a keyboard shortcut (Cmd+Shift+U / Ctrl+Shift+U) and switch to the next loaded tab.

description.en-US:
Press Cmd+Shift+U (macOS) or Ctrl+Shift+U (Windows/Linux) to unload the tab you're on. Firefox frees its memory and CPU, and you're taken to the next loaded tab, skipping ones that are already unloaded.

The unloaded tab stays in the tab bar and reloads when you click it again. It's the same as the built-in "Unload Tab" item in the tab context menu, just on a key.

Change the shortcut: about:addons → gear icon → Manage Extension Shortcuts.

No permissions, no data collection. Source code: https://github.com/semihsmg/quick-unload-tab
